subject: math
description: Solve probability problems involving intersections and overlaps of events.
learningObjectives: Solve probability problems involving intersections and overlaps of events.
Use intersection, overlap, and joint frequency vocabulary accurately.
Read Venn diagrams and two-way tables to identify outcomes in both events.
Compute P(A and B) using the overlap count and correct denominator.
Explain intersection probabilities in context and avoid union/intersection mistakes.
prerequisites: Identify the total number of outcomes in a sample space
Read counts from tables and Venn diagrams
Write a short explanation using evidence
